import axios from'axios';const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:3001/api';const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});export const applicationService={// Get all applications
getApplications:()=>api.get('/applications'),// Get application details
getApplicationDetails:id=>api.get("/applications/".concat(id)),// Submit new application
submitApplication:data=>api.post('/applications',data),// Officer action
submitAction:(id,action,officerId,notes)=>api.post("/applications/".concat(id,"/action"),{action,officerId,notes})};export const ruleService={// Get all rules
getRules:()=>api.get('/rules'),// Create rule
createRule:data=>api.post('/rules',data),// Update rule
updateRule:(id,data)=>api.put("/rules/".concat(id),data)};export default api;
